# T006 — Azure identity and XML-parser chain

## Summary

Patched the Azure identity/MSAL and storage XML dependency paths in both npm locks on Node v24.21.0 (npm 11.19.0). Both native audits now omit `@azure/identity`, `@azure/msal-node` and `fast-xml-parser`; all 35 offline characterization tests still pass. No ACS request, callback, application logic or deployment file changed.

## Changes

- `backend/package.json`: pin the first patched existing-major Azure identity release, `4.13.1` (previously `^4.13.0`). An exact version avoids silently accepting later identity 4.x releases that change the MSAL major again.
- `package-lock.json`: regenerated with npm workspace commands `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --workspace backend '@azure/identity@^4.13.1'`, then the same install with `--save-exact '@azure/identity@4.13.1'`, followed by `npm update @azure/core-xml fast-xml-parser --workspace backend --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund`. npm rehoisted the shared Azure and storage subtree. The backend's exact identity is 4.13.1 with MSAL Node 5.6.0; the separately resolved frontend Static Web Apps CLI dependency `^4.3.0` receives identity 4.14.0 with MSAL Node 6.0.1. Both are within the existing identity major; neither MSAL path retains the vulnerable `uuid@8.3.2` dependency. This transitive MSAL major change is necessary because MSAL Node 3.8.10 still declares `uuid ^8.3.0`.
- `backend/package-lock.json`: regenerated with npm `npm install --prefix backend --workspaces=false --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --save-exact '@azure/identity@4.13.1'` and `npm update @azure/core-xml fast-xml-parser --prefix backend --workspaces=false --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund`. Both locks now resolve Azure core-xml 1.6.0 and fast-xml-parser 5.11.2, compatible with the existing storage-blob `^1.4.5` core-xml dependency and core-xml's `^5.5.9` parser requirement.

## Decisions

Checked 2026-10-21 UTC against the current npm 11.19.0 audit reports, npm registry manifests (`npm view`), `npm explain` in each install context and linked GitHub advisories. [Node's release schedule](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodejs/Release/main/schedule.json) confirms Node 24 maintenance LTS through 2028-04-30. `npm explain` establishes two **distinct** paths: backend `@azure/identity → @azure/msal-node → uuid`, also imported by TTS/storage credential paths; and backend `@azure/storage-blob → @azure/core-xml → fast-xml-parser`, not an MSAL-owned XML package. Static Web Apps CLI has a separate frontend developer dependency on identity. XML parsing via storage responses is plausible, although no XML input received from storage or XMLBuilder attacker-controlled comments/CDATA are exercised by the offline tests. The credential chain is reachable when Azure credentials are used; the affected UUID methods require an externally supplied small buffer or bad offset, not demonstrated in the backend. No major change to the direct identity or storage-blob packages, no override and no audit suppression.

## Validation

- All exact full gates run **after the final package edit**, from repository root under `CI=true TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8`, `/opt/node/24/bin` first on PATH: `npm ci` passed; `npm run build --if-present` passed (three pre-existing CSS optimizer warnings); `npm test` passed **35/35** (backend 15 ACS/HTTP, frontend 20, failed 0, skipped 0); `npm run lint --if-present` passed with the pre-existing five warnings and zero errors.
- Additional exact gates: `npm ci --prefix backend` passed. `bash /shared/skills/dependency-vulnerability-remediation/scripts/scan-dependencies.sh --output-dir .modernization-scratch/scan .` exited **2** because **unrelated** advisories remain; both native npm audits completed, neither scan is incomplete. Root 47 affected package names (3 critical, 32 high, 9 moderate, 3 low), backend 9 (0 critical, 7 high, 2 moderate). The root's three remaining critical package names are unrelated to the XML parser; backend has zero remaining critical findings. Reports are local-only under `.modernization-scratch/scan/`. `git diff --check` passed.

## Follow-ups and risks

- Remaining root and backend findings are **open, not accepted**: speech SDK, nodemon, frontend build/lint/development chains and non-MSAL UUID copies are assigned T007–T013. Their presence explains scanner exit 2.
- Offline characterization cannot prove live Azure identity acquisition, blob protocol handling or deployed ACS integration. Keep both locks independently validated in subsequent tasks. npm rehoisted packages and resolved additional compatible same-major transitive patches in the root lock; review that lock diff as part of high-risk task review.
